name: Sjögren Syndrome
definition: Systemic autoimmune disease primarily affecting exocrine glands, causing sicca symptoms with possible musculoskeletal, neurological and pulmonary involvement.

investigations.principle: Autoantibodies and objective ocular/salivary testing are used according to clinical need.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Systemic immunomodulation depends on organ involvement.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Rasa/Rakta dryness phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Systemic autoimmune disease primarily affecting exocrine glands, causing sicca symptoms with possible musculoskeletal, neurological and pulmonary involvement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
